title: The Language of the family house on Kessler Street
author: M. M. Vane
blurb: Ada Blackwood, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
